title: Zalo group
intro: Connect your own Zalo bot so the tournament's Zalo group gets announcements automatically. The bot only posts; it never replies.
closed: This tournament has ended, so its Zalo settings can no longer change.

notConfigured.title: Zalo posting is not set up yet
notConfigured.body: This server is not ready to keep Zalo bot keys yet, so a key cannot be saved now. Ask the platform admin to turn on Zalo posting, then come back here.

status.title: Connection
status.none: No Zalo bot yet. Follow the steps below to connect one.
status.waiting: Waiting for a mention in the group
status.webhookProblem: Zalo did not accept the link to this app yet, so mentions may not reach us. Save the key again to retry.

create.title: Create a Zalo bot
create.body: In the Zalo Bot Creator, create a bot for your group and copy its key.

paste.title: Paste its key here
paste.body: Paste the key below and save. We check it with Zalo and keep it encrypted.

add.title: Add the bot to the group
add.body: In your Zalo group, add the bot as a member.

mention.title: Mention the bot in the group
mention.body: Send a message that mentions the bot (@bot name). The group is then linked and the bot posts the introduction.

key.title: Bot key
key.label: Zalo bot key
key.hint: The key is never shown again after saving; only its last 4 characters are.

remove.title: Remove from this tournament
remove.confirm: Remove the bot from this tournament? It stops posting this tournament's news. Your other tournaments that use the bot are not affected.

errors.notConfigured: Zalo posting is not set up on this server yet. Ask the platform admin.
errors.rejected: Zalo did not accept this key. Check it and try again.
errors.unreachable: Zalo could not be reached. Try again later.
errors.closed: This tournament has ended, so its Zalo settings can no longer change.
errors.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.
